chapter_seo_title: The Void Nian Attacks — Dao Gui Yi Xian Chapter 551
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang is almost out of Great Qi, but a terrifying new creature blocks his path: the Void Nian, a beast that feeds on lifespans, not flesh.
og_title: When the Nian Beast Stops Being Fun
og_description: Li Huowang faces a monstrous fusion of woman and lion that drains the years from your life with a single touch.
twitter_title: The Void Nian Has No Patience for Exit Plans
twitter_description: Li Huowang meets the creature that made "New Year" a threat, and it does not care about his escape route.

lore_anchors.definition: A legendary beast in Chinese folklore that emerges at year's end to terrorize villages, traditionally driven away by firecrackers and the color red. In this novel, it is reimagined as a life-draining predator.
A corrupted version of the Nian beast that feeds on yang life (lifespan) through physical contact. Its human face and beast body suggest it occupies a liminal space between spirit and animal.
A term in Chinese folk religion and xianxia for a person's natural lifespan, often depicted as a fixed quantity that can be drained or stolen by supernatural means.
A mineral that emits a faint glow used for illumination in the Dao-Twisted World, reinforcing the setting's primitive, gritty survival aesthetic.
A named location serving as Li Huowang's exit point from Great Qi, representing his last hope of escaping the Heavenly Calamity.
